context.person: A person using a hotel booking service
context.user_goal: Choose the alternative with paid transport or request a full refund.

product_state.preceding_state: The booked hotel cannot honor tonight's reservation and offered a nearby property.
product_state.current_state: The original reservation is unavailable. The alternative hotel is 1.2 miles away.
known_facts: The alternative hotel is 1.2 miles away.
The room type and nightly rate are the same.
The service will pay for transport or provide a full refund.
forbidden_claims: The alternative has already been accepted.
The alternative is in the same building.
A refund excludes taxes and fees.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: Some details have changed. Review your account.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand hotel overbooking alternative, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Accept the alternative hotel and arrange transport.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Decline and request a full refund.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The traveler has no room at the original hotel tonight.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Choose the alternative with paid transport or request a full refund.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
